en.connRequestSentBanner: Request sent — they can reply after accepting

@connRequestSentBanner.description: Sender's chat with someone who has not accepted the message request yet (banner above the composer).

en.connNoLinksYet: Links can be sent after they accept your request.

@connNoLinksYet.description: Toast: the sender typed a link (http / www) in a message request; only plain text goes before accept.

@connConnectedLine.description: Centred system line in a 1:1 chat at the moment the request was accepted (both phones).

@connAudioCall.description: Button on a My Circle contact sheet / contact info: start an audio call.

@connVideoCall.description: Button on a My Circle contact sheet / contact info: start a video call.

@connDecline.description: Message request bar: decline the request (the sender is not told).

@connDeclineTitle.description: Confirm dialog title before declining a message request.

en.connDeclineBody: {name} won't be told, and their messages won't reach you.

@connDeclineBody.description: Confirm dialog body before declining a message request.

@connDeclinedToast.description: Toast after declining a message request.

bn.connRequestSentBanner: অনুরোধ পাঠানো হয়েছে — গ্রহণ করলে উনি উত্তর দিতে পারবেন
bn.connNoLinksYet: অনুরোধ গ্রহণ করার পর লিংক পাঠাতে পারবেন।
bn.connDeclineBody: {name}-কে জানানো হবে না, আর তাঁর মেসেজ আপনার কাছে আসবে না।
